events.description: Worker initially attempted long JSON through a terminal despite instructions to use subprocess stdin; terminal checker was interrupted and closed without a submission.
Misspelled handoff-hold command was rejected before any holder or output.
Local review socket failed under sandbox; identical candidate was then held with approved escalation.

recovery: Worker used safely quoted Node subprocess input carrying exact existing in-memory bytes. Final held and saved hashes authenticated; no canonical output existed at any failed transport.
